companies.name: OpenAI
companies.description: Develops frontier AI models and ChatGPT. Its for-profit business is OpenAI Group PBC, controlled by the OpenAI Foundation. Its June 2026 confidential S-1 announcement described it as private; an IPO filing is not a completed stock-market listing.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.description: Develops the Claude family of AI models and enterprise AI services. A Delaware public benefit corporation. Its June 2026 filing proposed a future IPO; it did not announce completed public trading.

companies.name: Mistral AI
companies.description: French AI company developing frontier models and customizable AI solutions for enterprises and industrial applications. Its legal notice identifies Paris registration 952418325. Private-market status is corroborated by Forge.

relationships.summary: Microsoft remains OpenAI’s primary cloud partner under the April 2026 amended agreement. OpenAI can also serve products through other cloud providers; the partnership is not exclusive.
Anthropic uses Amazon's AWS Trainium chips for Claude workloads. The April 2026 announcement describes existing Trainium2 use, alongside commitments for additional future capacity.
Anthropic announced expanded TPU capacity with Alphabet through Google, alongside Broadcom. The additional capacity is expected to start coming online in 2027, not already delivered.
Anthropic announced a compute agreement with Broadcom and Google for additional TPU capacity expected from 2027. This records the agreement, not completed delivery.

Mistral AI and ASML announced a strategic partnership to explore AI-enabled products and engineering solutions for ASML's customers. The source also records ASML's investment; it does not establish a chip-supply contract.
